title: Government Property Inspectors and Investigators
description: Investigate or inspect government property to ensure compliance with contract agreements and government regulations.

tasks.text: Prepare correspondence, reports of inspections or investigations, or recommendations for action.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Status notifications drafted and sent by AI

dwas.name: Inform individuals or organizations of status or findings.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Examine records, reports, or other documents to establish facts or detect discrepancies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial accuracy checks, human reviews exceptions

tasks.text: Inspect government property, such as construction sites or public housing, to ensure compliance with contract specifications or legal requirements.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical spec verification of facilities/equipment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities or equipment to ensure specifications are met.

tasks.text: Investigate alleged license or permit violations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Screens applications against criteria; human owns approval

dwas.name: Review license or permit applications.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Inspect manufactured or processed products to ensure compliance with contract specifications or legal requirements.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product compliance check against regulations, human verifies

dwas.name: Examine product information to ensure compliance with regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Collect, identify, evaluate, or preserve case evidence.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Evidence collection is fieldwork with chain of custody

tasks.text: Submit samples of products to government laboratories for testing, as required.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Drafting agency communications aided; relationships human

dwas.name: Communicate with government agencies.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Inspect government-owned equipment or materials in the possession of private contractors to ensure compliance with contracts or regulations or to prevent misuse.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical spec verification of facilities/equipment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities or equipment to ensure specifications are met.

tasks.text: Investigate applications for special licenses or permits.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Legal research strong, judgment and accountability human

tasks.text: Recommend legal or administrative action to protect government property.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance guidance drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Advise others on legal or regulatory compliance matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Testify in court or at administrative proceedings concerning investigation findings.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Testimony carries legal accountability and live presence

dwas.name: Testify at legal or legislative proceedings.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Coordinate with or assist law enforcement agencies in matters of mutual concern.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcement coordination requires legal authority and presence

dwas.name: Coordinate enforcement of laws or regulations.

tasks.text: Monitor investigations of suspected offenders to ensure that they are conducted in accordance with constitutional requirements.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI tracks regulatory compliance across documents

emerging_tasks.task: Use emerging technologies, such as drones, for remote or automated inspections.
